summary: Practise HACCP, hygiene controls, traceability, recall planning, and buyer-audit preparation. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Food-safety systems training helps food processors, quality managers, and supply-chain supervisors apply controls across handling, processing, storage, and distribution. Participants practise assessing biological, chemical, and physical hazards, checking hygiene and prerequisite programmes, and maintaining monitoring and traceability records. They also develop recall workflows and organize evidence for buyer audits, connecting documented procedures with day-to-day food operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, inspect, or support food-safety controls across agricultural processing, storage, distribution, export supply, and institutional food service.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with food handling, food processing, quality assurance, inspection, or supply-chain operations will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to work through the digital traceability and monitoring worksheets.
